what: ReproBot repo mode on real, already-fixed GitHub issues. Scores are hand-read, not automatic.
notes: Inputs per case: the reporter's video, the issue title, and operator configuration (repo, pre-fix SHA, install/start command, local URL, test command). The issue body, the fix PR and the fix were never given to the pipeline. The reviewer read them only afterwards, to score.

Limits: 20 minutes per case; inside that, 12 minutes for the reproduce step and the remainder for the fix step. Three cases (drawdb858, panels650, drawdb687) hit the 12-minute reproduce limit. Own tests: the fix prompt caps each test run at 4 minutes. chogan's `node tools/test.js` did not finish inside that cap in the sandbox in any of the three chogan cases, so those are 'inconclusive', not 'passing'. Cypress/Playwright e2e suites (wavesurfer.js, sonner) and the large recharts root suite were not run at all.

'fixed per own script' means the pipeline's own claim (its reproduction printed BUG_ABSENT after the patch). No independent verifier was run on these cases, unlike the planted-bug evaluation. import sys
import time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

URL = "http://localhost:9090/#basic.js"
SCREENSHOT_PATH = "/workspace/repro_wavesurfer2963.png"


def get_waveform_metrics(page):
    """Return bounding box of .wrapper and current progress/cursor percentages from inside iframe#preview."""
    return page.evaluate("""() => {
        const iframe = document.querySelector('iframe#preview');
        if (!iframe || !iframe.contentDocument) return null;
        const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
        const iframeRect = iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Find shadow host inside iframe body
        const hosts = Array.from(doc.body.children).filter(el => el.shadowRoot);
        if (hosts.length === 0) return null;
        const shadow = hosts[0].shadowRoot;
        const wrapper = shadow.querySelector('.wrapper');
        const progress = shadow.querySelector('.progress');
        const cursor = shadow.querySelector('.cursor');
        if (!wrapper || !progress || !cursor) return null;
        const rect = wrapper.getBoundingClientRect();
        const canvas = shadow.querySelector('canvas');
        if (!canvas || rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return null;
        return {
            x: iframeRect.left + rect.left,
            y: iframeRect.top + rect.top,
            width: rect.width,
            height: rect.height,
            progressWidth: progress.style.width,
            cursorLeft: cursor.style.left,
            progressPct: parseFloat(progress.style.width) || 0,
            cursorPct: parseFloat(cursor.style.left) || 0,
        };
    }""")


def main():
    save_screenshot = "--screenshot" in sys.argv

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(
            executable_path="/usr/bin/google-chrome",
            headless=True,
        )
        context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1280, "height": 800})

            if metrics and metrics["width"] > 100:

            time.sleep(0.1)

        if not metrics:
            print("BUG_ABSENT (waveform failed to render)")
            if save_screenshot:
                page.screenshot(path=SCREENSHOT_PATH)
            browser.close()
            return

        wx = metrics["x"]
        wy = metrics["y"]
        ww = metrics["width"]
        wh = metrics["height"]
        mid_y = wy + wh / 2

        # Step 1 (t=1.8s): Left-click audio waveform around 20% from the left edge
        page.mouse.click(wx + ww * 0.20, mid_y, button="left")
        time.sleep(0.5)

        # Step 2 (t=3.2s): Right-click audio waveform around 35% from the left edge
        page.mouse.click(wx + ww * 0.35, mid_y, button="right")
        time.sleep(0.5)

        # Step 3 (t=4.2s): Click area just below the waveform to dismiss the context menu
        page.mouse.click(wx + ww * 0.35, wy + wh + 30, button="left")
        time.sleep(0.3)

        # Step 4 (t=4.8s): Left-click audio waveform near the left edge (~4%)

        time.sleep(0.5)

        # Step 5 (t=6.2s): Right-click audio waveform near the middle (~48%)

        time.sleep(0.5)

        # Step 6 (t=7.1s): Click audio waveform just to the left of the context menu to dismiss it
        page.mouse.click(wx + ww * 0.20, mid_y, button="left")
        time.sleep(0.3)

        # Step 7 (t=7.5s+): Move mouse pointer horizontally across and above the waveform without pressing any button
        # Test multiple horizontal positions: 75%, 15%, and 81% above the waveform
        page.mouse.move(wx + ww * 0.75, mid_y, steps=10)
        time.sleep(0.15)
        m_75 = get_waveform_metrics(page)

        time.sleep(0.15)
        m_15 = get_waveform_metrics(page)

        page.mouse.move(wx + ww * 0.81, wy - 20, steps=10)
        time.sleep(0.15)
        m_81 = get_waveform_metrics(page)

        if save_screenshot:
            page.screenshot(path=SCREENSHOT_PATH)

        # Check: moving the mouse pointer horizontally with no button pressed causes

        # Specifically: when pointer moved to 75%, progress jumped near ~75%;

    page.mouse.down()
    page.mouse.move(cx, cy + dy, steps=steps)
    # Check intermediate transform/swipe-amount while pointer is still down
    mid_swipe = page.evaluate(

            const el = document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toast]');
            if (!el) return null;
            return {
                swipeAmount: el.style.getPropertyValue('--swipe-amount'),
                rectY: el.getBoundingClientRect().y
            };
        }"""
    )
    page.mouse.up()
    return mid_swipe
